Population increased in Ribble Valley

The estimated population of Ribble Valley in 2024 was 65,794 usual residents, a rise of 1.6% since 2023.

This meant that Ribble Valley's rate of population change placed it about average among local authority districts in England and Wales.

In the period from mid-2021 to mid-2024, the population estimate of Ribble Valley increased by 6.4%.

Over this slightly longer period, Ribble Valley was also among the 10% fastest growing local authority districts in England and Wales.

Age profile of Ribble Valley

The average (median) age stayed at 48.5 years between 2023 and 2024.

You can see how the age profile of Ribble Valley has changed since 2011 in the population pyramid below.

sections.content:
Ribble Valley is an area that is classed as rural in nature according to the 2021 Census Rural Urban Classification.

By age category, Ribble Valley's population of 65,794 usual residents was made up of:

  • 10,552 people aged 0 to 15 years, (16%)
  • 38,748 people aged 16 to 64 years, (58.9%)
  • 16,494 people aged 65 years and over, (25.1%)

    • Compared with England and Wales as a whole, Ribble Valley has a higher proportion of people aged 65 years and over (25.1% compared with 18.9% for England and Wales).

Contributors to population change

We look at different flows of people into and out of areas and births and deaths to see what is driving population change in each area.

In Ribble Valley, the largest contribution to population change in the year to mid-2024 was from net internal migration.

sections.title: Contributors to population change in Ribble Valley
sections.subtitle: How the population changed, by component

sections.content:
We estimate that, for Ribble Valley, between 2023 and 2024:

  • More deaths than births led to a fall in the population of 190 people (-0.3%). In total, there were 481 births and 671 deaths in Ribble Valley.
  • Net internal migration (people moving to and from other areas in the UK) increased the population by 1,105 (1.7%). There were 4,594 people entering the area and 3,489 people leaving the area.
  • Net international migration led to an increase in Ribble Valley's population of 133 (0.2%) as a result of 316 people entering the area and 183 people leaving the area.
  • Other change (which includes changes to armed forces personnel and prisoners) for Ribble Valley was less than 0.1%.

Revisions to 2023 population estimates

We regularly revise our initial population estimates as we get more data and methods improve.

Our revised estimate for the population of Ribble Valley in mid-2023 is 64,736.

Within this, international migration was revised upwards by 172 people and internal migration estimates were revised upwards by 95 people.

Overall, there was an revision upwards of 267 people.
